title: DOE EM infrastructure: Savannah River's facility and maintenance denominator
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named U.S. agencies
summary: GAO reports that Savannah River had 1,842 facilities as of June 2025, including 436 mission-critical facilities; 67 mission-critical facilities had poor or very poor condition indexes. Operating facilities had $313.2 million in annual actual maintenance, $14.8 million in annual required maintenance, $285.8 million in deferred maintenance, and $527.9 million in repair needs. Denominator: Savannah River facilities and operating-or-standby maintenance measures as of June 2025.
